training_occupancy.interval_semantics: finetune manifest stop is exclusive for even train_games; experiment manifests use inclusive last seed; includes conservative prefill if no buffer_loaded and declared prefill_games>0; explicit prose ranges under500000 conservatively excluded
training_occupancy.prefill_caution: Recommended gaps concern main-training maps only. Reusing standard finetune prefill at base+5000 can overlap older normal training. Use an already-loaded buffer, prefill_games=0, or separately audit a fresh prefill design.
training_occupancy.conservative_prose_note: Explicit prose envelopes (for example235000–286999 spanning multiple disjoint start blocks) are conservatively excluded in full; listed gaps are safe lower-bound availability, not an exhaustive exact catalogue of every free seed.
